items.stem: Which anatomical plane divides the body into left and right portions?

options.rationale: Correct: the sagittal plane runs vertically and separates left from right.
The transverse plane divides the body into superior and inferior parts.
The frontal plane divides anterior from posterior.
An oblique plane is any slanted plane, not the standard left-right divider.

items.explanation: Correct: the sagittal plane runs vertically and separates left from right.

items.stem: Body temperature rising above its set point triggers sweating, which cools the body back toward the set point. Which TWO statements describe this mechanism? (Select TWO.)

options.text: It is an example of negative feedback
options.rationale: Correct: the response opposes the change and returns the variable toward its set point.

options.text: It is an example of positive feedback
options.rationale: Positive feedback amplifies a change rather than reversing it.

options.text: A receptor, control centre and effector are involved
options.rationale: Correct: feedback loops use a receptor, a control centre and an effector.

options.text: It permanently resets the body's set point higher
options.rationale: The set point is unchanged; the loop restores the original value.
An effector (sweat glands) carries out the corrective response.

items.explanation: Correct: the response opposes the change and returns the variable toward its set point.

items.stem: Which tissue type is specialised to contract and generate movement?

options.rationale: Correct: muscle tissue contracts to produce movement.
Epithelial tissue covers surfaces and lines cavities.
Connective tissue supports and binds other tissues.
Nervous tissue transmits signals but does not contract.

items.explanation: Correct: muscle tissue contracts to produce movement.
